auth.usernameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
auth.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.setupIntro: Create the administrator account. There is no default password: this account will be the only one able to create others.
auth.sessionExpired: Session expired, please sign in again.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.passwordIntro: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.
prefs.passwordChanged: Password changed, your other sessions are signed out.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Admins drive fail2ban and manage the app, read-only accounts can only look.
users.roleChanged: Role of {{username}} changed, their sessions are signed out.
users.passwordResetHint: At least 10 characters. Their open sessions will be signed out.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: For scripts and the MCP server. A token cannot manage users or other tokens: these pages need a session.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.nameHint: To recognize it later, for example "backup script".
tokens.expiresHint: Leave empty for a token that never expires (not recommended).
tokens.scopesHint: admin includes write, write includes read.
tokens.instancesHint: With nothing selected, the token reaches every instance.
tokens.secretWarning: Copy it now: it will never be shown again. Only its hash is stored.
tokens.instancesAdminHint: The admin scope is global: it cannot be limited to some instances.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change and sign-in, most recent first.

instances.title: Instances
instances.intro: Each instance is a fail2ban driven by BanviewR, with its own socket and database.

reason.socket: The fail2ban socket answers: BanviewR uses the host's fail2ban.
reason.process: A fail2ban-server process is running: BanviewR uses the host's fail2ban.
reason.service: The fail2ban service is installed: BanviewR uses the host's fail2ban.
reason.none: No fail2ban found when the server started. Embedded mode comes in v0.2.

instances.name: Name
instances.deleted: Instance {{name}} removed. Fail2ban and its bans are not touched.
instances.conflict: This name or socket is already used by another instance.
instances.lastInstance: The last instance cannot be removed.

jails.title: Jails
jails.intro: Running jails and current bans of the chosen instance.
jails.name: Jail
jails.empty: No running jail on this instance.
jails.targetHint: For example 203.0.113.7 or 203.0.113.0/24. Network of at least /8 in IPv4, /16 in IPv6.
jails.ownAddress: Refused: this rule would ban your own address.

done.stop: Jail {{name}} stopped. Its bans no longer apply and come back when it restarts.

errors.CONFLICT: Not possible in the current state.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.LOCKED: Too many failures: account temporarily locked, retry in 15 minutes.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests, please wait a moment.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: fail2ban does not answer for this instance.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Ban history of the chosen instance, kept locally by BanviewR even after fail2ban purges its own. Updated every minute.
stats.perHour: Bans per hour of the day
stats.unlocated_one: {{count}} ban with no known country (private address or missing from the database).
stats.unlocated_other: {{count}} bans with no known country (private addresses or missing from the database).
stats.noGeo: No known country for these bans. An admin can install a local geolocation database from the Geolocation page.

geoip.title: Geolocation
geoip.intro: Country and network operator of banned addresses, read from local databases: no address is sent to an online service. Without a database BanviewR works as usual, without countries.
geoip.downloadInfo: Downloads the free Country and ASN databases from download.db-ip.com (about 10 MB). The request carries no address and no ban data, DB-IP only sees the address of this server. Nothing is downloaded without this click: DB-IP publishes a new release every month, come back here to update.
geoip.manualInfo: You can also drop country.mmdb and asn.mmdb (DB-IP Lite or MaxMind GeoLite2) yourself in the geoip folder of the BanviewR data directory (data/geoip by default). They are picked up within a minute, no restart needed.

ip.notBanned: This address is not banned right now.
ip.noHistory: No ban of this address in the history.
